invariants.rationale: The method requires a valid fileName to resolve the map file; null is likely not supported.
The parameter argument is used to access several fields (e.g., generateMipMaps, textureMinFilter, textureMagFilter), so it must not be null.
A non-empty fileName is required to resolve a file; empty string likely causes errors.
File names consisting only of whitespace are likely invalid in this context.
Texture filters are used for setting texture properties; these should be non-null before usage.
